entries.reason: Script component identity, version and entry structure use a typed Protobuf payload; runtime-defined field values use DynamicValue.
entries.schema: eve:script-components version 2 is ScriptComponentStoreSave inside BinarySnapshotEnvelope.
entries.version: Binary writers emit version 2; the version 1 JSON snapshot remains readable through its compatibility API.
entries.migration: A version 1 JSON snapshot can be restored and recaptured through the version 2 binary writer.
entries.unknown_fields: Binary restore rejects unknown Protobuf fields recursively, unknown components and undeclared dynamic fields.
entries.restore_atomicity: All entries validate in a detached candidate map before replacing the authoritative store.

entries.reason: The engine foundation exposes typed binary script component persistence in addition to its tool JSON view.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for this foundation change.

entries.thread_affinity: Snapshot and restore run on the script component store owner thread and invoke only the injected hash provider.
cost_notes: Binary save and restore cost linear time in component entries and dynamic field bytes per snapshot.
